name: Donut Division

features.name: Gooey Guns
features.description: Fire a row of wilds to the left.

features.name: Row multipliers
features.description: Every wild on a row shares the gun's 1x–100x value.

features.name: Multi-row wins
features.description: Lines can collect multipliers from several rows.

review:
Cops in a doughnut shop with Gooey Guns. When a gun lands, it fires gooey wilds to the left across its row, then turns wild itself – and guns can land with multipliers from 1x to 100x that every wild on that row shares.

If a winning line passes through gooey rows from several guns, all their multipliers count, so two decent guns on different rows can make a very big hit. 12,500x max. Sources disagree on its RTP, so we don't list one.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
